claims.source_support: Source supports a defined engineered reporter
claims.evidence: PCR/Sanger confirmation of integration; constitutive mCitrine construct, GAP1-proximal insertion and neutral-locus controls.
claims.nonimplication: Integration verification is not ancestral/new-event truth for later spontaneous CNVs.
claims.admission_decision: Source construction facts only; native assay unselected.

claims.evidence: Engineered haploid/diploid copy controls and forward-scatter normalization.
claims.nonimplication: Does not cover all CNV architectures, missed negatives, all routes, or native SBW25 transport.
claims.admission_decision: Reporter classification precedent; no native calibration parameter.

claims.evidence: T_up requires apparent CNV fraction exceeding 7.1%, defined as mean+one SD of evolving one-copy controls at generations 1–153.
claims.nonimplication: This is not per-event FPR, confidence bound, mutation birth, or earlier establishment.

claims.source_support: Source supports genotypes of selected later clones
claims.evidence: 29 increased-fluorescence clones from generations 150/250 were sequenced; read-depth/Southern checks support CNV structures.
claims.nonimplication: Selected recovered survivors do not authenticate every earlier focus/gate call or provide a complete negative frame.

claims.source_support: Source supports phenotype remeasurement after culture
claims.evidence: FACS fractions regrown 48 h; isolated clones rechecked by flow; at least 25 clones per subpopulation for correction.
claims.nonimplication: Independent flow analysis remains the same phenotype modality; no event-specific sequence truth or false-negative denominator.
claims.admission_decision: Do not substitute late WGS for this correction method.

claims.evidence: Unique barcodes shared by multiple founding cells; complex CNV may require successive events.
claims.nonimplication: Barcode count is not a one-to-one independent event count.

claims.evidence: Common cross-population barcode may be preexisting; independent new CNVs in that barcode are possible.
claims.nonimplication: Population-specific barcode is not an independently genotype-negative ancestor; indistinguishable precursor histories remain.
claims.admission_decision: No inherited-negative truth or individual acquisition time.

claims.source_support: Source supports high-supply interpretation conditional on selection/detection
claims.evidence: Observed CNV-lineage diversity and population dynamics motivate inference of high supply.
claims.nonimplication: No independent event-level exposure, unseen-loss denominator or route-specific birth census.

claims.source_support: Source provides separate pairwise competition assays
claims.evidence: Evolved clones compete with nonfluorescent FY4 in glutamine-limited chemostats; relative abundance followed every 2–3 generations over about 15 generations.
claims.nonimplication: The reported competition and sequencing denominators are 28 and 29 and require an explicit clone-level join; this does not imply disjoint cohorts. Pairwise competitive growth is not new-mutant establishment in resident ecology.

claims.source_support: Source provides limited conditional control evidence
claims.evidence: No significant fitness defect in source controls; other source controls form GAP1 CNVs by DNA/Southern.
claims.nonimplication: No quantitative equivalence bound, complete mutation-spectrum invariance or native transport proof.

claims.source_support: Source text has distinct denominators and timing labels
claims.evidence: Original 26 experimental plus 6 controls; six barcode populations; two barcode-sequenced populations; 29 WGS versus 28 fitness clones; Results 270 versus FACS Methods 265.
claims.nonimplication: Do not merge populations, cells, clones, barcodes, mutation events or silently correct times.
claims.admission_decision: Keep source joins and discrepancies explicit.

claims.source_support: Source remains foreign to actual native TMD admission
claims.evidence: Yeast GAP1 copy-number measurement architecture; neither SBW25 nor matched W/A/M routes.
claims.nonimplication: No native parental/event ancestry, supply, establishment, recovery/loss or matched transport.
claims.admission_decision: 0 native panels; 0 native fits; 26 study and 18 planning NULLs unchanged.

falsifiable_boundary: If a future TMD analysis equates a reporter-labelled lineage with one newly born, independently established mutation, independent genotyping that finds target variants among reporter-negative units, no target variant among reporter-positive units, preexisting target variants in ancestors, or multiple founders/events per label refutes the corresponding perfect-classification or one-to-one claim. Calibrated classification may still be supported with actual denominators and uncertainty; no such native dataset is admitted.
next_named_artifact_rule: Only acquire a bounded licensed clone-level fluorescence/sequence crosswalk with selection, ancestry, missingness and denominator metadata, or an actual DNA-genotyped positive/negative sorting-control set that can change a specific gate.
